verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Sprinto's own SOC 2 Launchpad guide, which says users generate a blueprint and 'action policies.' That confirms policies are handled in-product but says nothing about the depth of that handling. The GDPR document pack in the compliance-skills repo is generated from code scans, not a policy template library with lifecycle management. missing for 10: lawyer-grade policy template library, in-app policy editor, policy versioning, approval workflow, per-employee acceptance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
